title: Ophthalmic Bioengineering and Biomaterials
body_html:
Ophthalmic Bioengineering and Biomaterials research is dedicated to the development of materials that aim to treat or replace damaged or diseased tissue in the eye.

Our research focuses on:

  • Development and optimization of silk-based templates for tissue-engineered constructs
  • Novel surgical adhesives
  • Therapies based on photochemical crosslinking of collagenous tissues
  • Antioxidants for retinal pathologies
  • Photothermal therapy for retinal artery occlusion caused by dermal facial treatments
  • Novel concept for developing an artificial corneal endothelium
  • Investigating scar tissue formation in age-related macular degeneration
